sections.title: David's Recognition as King and Capture of Jerusalem

blocks.text: All Israel gathered at Hebron to formally recognize David as king. The elders of Israel came to the king and made a covenant with him before the Lord, anointing him as king in accordance with the word delivered by Samuel. Following this formal consolidation of kingship, David and all Israel went to Jerusalem. The Jebusites, who inhabited the city, initially resisted David's entry, but he captured their stronghold, which became known as the city of David. This capture of Jerusalem established it as the central city of David's kingdom, marking a significant shift from Hebron as the seat of recognition to Jerusalem as the seat of power.
